verdict.rationale: Netlify documents building APIs with serverless functions, managed Postgres (Netlify Database), and instant databases and file storage (getStore blobs), with framework templates for full-stack apps (Remix + Supabase, Angular, Clerk B2C). Community users confirm zero-config Lambda functions, moving apps off Heroku, and choosing Netlify specifically to avoid self-hosting. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on function runtimes and limits, and explicit first-party evidence of edge functions (only mentioned indirectly in the Turso integration listing).
